data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 再走一次的桥
data.description: 蕾娜拉着你走上那座熟悉的木桥，提醒你看水里慢慢飘走的落叶。她记得第一次来穗织时，自己也在这里停了很久。
data.action: holding her partner’s hand on a wooden bridge
data.promptProse: On a wooden bridge over a stream, Lena takes her partner’s hand and looks back with a smile; only the partner’s hand is visible.
data.animaCaption: Her partner is out of frame apart from the hand she holds.
